frame.THIS_IS_NOT_MORPHOMETRY: Every position here is DECLARED by this file, not measured from any specimen and not derived from any ontology. chain.requirement: The designed organism must take up inorganic carbon (CO2/HCO3-) and put it into biomass while also swimming; this ladder asks which enzymes and which pathway actually carry the carbon, and which cell structure carries the swimming.
chain.species_caveat: Unusually for this project the evidence IS the designed organism's own species - every link but one comes from C. necator / R. eutropha H16 itself - but it is the wild type or a metabolically engineered H16, never the designed construct, and the PhaR binding and reporter assays in l10 were run with purified protein and in E. coli rather than in C. necator.

missing_rungs.why: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A C. necator transposon or deletion screen scoring aggregation, biofilm or co-culture phenotypes in this organism directly, instead of importing phenotypes from other genera.

missing_rungs.why: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. The ladder for a bacterium terminates at cell component and cell level, and the tissue rung should be recorded as not-applicable rather than left blank.

missing_rungs.why: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. For this organism a 3D view must be a single cell with sub-cellular compartments, not an anatomy.

missing_rungs.why: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A soft-agar swim-plate or single-cell tracking assay on H16 wild type versus a fliC or flhDC deletion, under the autotrophic gas condition the design assumes, plus a chemotaxis assay against a defined attractant. Until that exists, any claim that the designed organism swims should be marked unverified.

missing_rungs.why: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A closed carbon and electron balance from a gas fermentation: gCDW and gPHB per mol CO2 consumed, with H2 and O2 uptake measured under defined autotrophic conditions. Until then the 55% figure rests on the model, not on literature.

missing_rungs.why: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Measurement of intracellular dissolved inorganic carbon and of CO2/HCO3- flux to RuBisCO in H16, plus a transporter deletion with a carbon-fixation readout rather than a growth readout.

missing_rungs.why: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A phaP1 deletion and a phaP1 overexpression strain of C. necator H16 with granule number and size scored by microscopy in the fetched document itself, plus an EMSA or reporter assay on the phaP1 promoter (not phaP3) to establish the direction of PhaR control of phaP1.

verification.verifier: adversarial verifier, DELPHI runs thread (separate agent from the builder)
verification.stance: disbelief by default: every quote re-matched mechanically in python against the fetched bytes; nothing was fetched, and no link was added.

method.quote_matching: Each link's quote was normalised (HTML entity unescape, unicode dash/quote/space folding, whitespace collapse) and searched as a substring in five normalisations of the file named in quote_from: raw bytes, XML tags stripped, XML tags replaced by a space, JSON string unescaping, and finally a whitespace-insensitive pass. A quote spanning tag boundaries therefore still matches, but a reworded quote cannot.
method.negative_control: The matcher was proved able to fail: a planted quote ("the carbonic anhydrase was observed to cause gliding flight in the organism") inserted into a scratch copy of this file was reported FAILED, 1 of 17, while the 16 real quotes still passed.
method.fetch_log_check: Every quote_from path was looked up in runs/_chains/log/carbon-eating-bacterium.fetch.json by its saved_to field and its status read from the log, not from the filename.

The EMSA quoted is on phaP3 binding sites, not on the link's target phaP1 (Methods name only PphaP3 fragments), and the paper's reporter assays conclude PhaR ACTIVATES phaP3 - the opposite sign to this link's relation "inhibits". No phaP1 binding or reporter experiment is in the document.

grades_checked_and_left_alone.l01: necessity upheld: the can deletion mutant was built in this paper (delta-RE delta-phaCAB background, deletion confirmed by clonal PCR) and the growth assay is in Figure 4C. numbers.the_bug_this_replaces: Until this run, that description produced a blueprint of Metazoa -- ALL ANIMALS -- with 8 organ systems, 38 organs and 138 cell types. The taxon silently defaulted to the widest animal clade whenever no taxon word was recognised, on the reasoning that the widest taxon removes no structure by taxon constraint. The reasoning is sound and the behaviour was not: the fallback does not merely relax the constraints, it decides what the organism IS. The word "bacterium" sat in words_not_recognised while the tool built an animal with organs, and nothing connected the two.

checks.body: "eats carbon" has at least four readings and they are different organisms: fixing CO2 from the air (autotrophy, which cyanobacteria and plants already do everywhere), oxidising hydrocarbons (Alcanivorax and the oil-degrading guild), depolymerising plastic (Ideonella sakaiensis on PET), or consuming elemental carbon, which essentially nothing does. This run takes the first reading and says so. No layer here disambiguates a request; the words are not read as English, and a tool that silently picked one of four would be guessing in the same way the Metazoa default was.

numbers.why: it is the reading with a real industrial chassis to name: Cupriavidus necator fixes CO2 through the Calvin cycle using hydrogen as the electron donor.

The molecular rungs are LITERATURE in Cupriavidus necator H16, Ralstonia eutropha H16 (the same strain under its former name), Escherichia coli (host for the PhaR reporter assays in link l10), each link graded and quoted. Unusually for this project the evidence IS the designed organism's own species - every link but one comes from C. necator / R. eutropha H16 itself - but it is the wild type or a metabolically engineered H16, never the designed construct, and the PhaR binding and reporter assays in l10 were run with purified protein and in E. coli rather than in C. necator.

Rung cell -> cell_cell is MISSING: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.

Rung cell_cell -> tissue is MISSING: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.

Rung tissue -> organ is MISSING: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.

Rung cell -> phenotype is MISSING: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.

Rung pathway -> phenotype is MISSING: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.

Rung molecule -> pathway is MISSING: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.

Rung molecule -> cell is MISSING: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.

blueprint-well-formedness.label: An emitted anatomical blueprint graph is well-formed under its own rules
blueprint-well-formedness.about: the part graph itself: that each term is a node, each parent relation is one Uberon or CL relation, and the graph has no cycle
blueprint-well-formedness.how: Structural only. It certifies that the blueprint is a well-formed graph over ontology terms — it says nothing about whether the part could exist, work, or bear a load. It is the one law in the set that reaches every part of every organism, and the weakest thing anyone could want to know about any of them.

thompson1917-ch03-07.label: Weight tends to vary as the cube of linear dimensions during growth
thompson1917-ch03-07.about: the slope of log mass against log length is 3 under isometry
thompson1917-ch03-07.how: The cube law as an exponent, which makes it testable: a measured slope that is not 3 is a measurement of how the organism departs from isometry. E1 is the observation that this project's fish do depart.

altitude-coupling.label: Demand rises and supply falls with height together, so the flyable heights reach down to the ground
altitude-coupling.about: that the feasible set is downward closed in altitude: feasible high implies feasible low
altitude-coupling.how: Couples the two layers: thinner air both reduces lift and reduces oxygen, so a design feasible at altitude is feasible below it. Useful mainly as a sanity direction on a scenario sweep.

physiology-q10.label: Q10 temperature scaling: the ratio between two temperatures is Q10 raised to their difference over ten
physiology-q10.about: how a rate changes with a ten-degree change in temperature
physiology-q10.how: Proved, no instance: no candidate commits a Q10 and the conditions file fixes 25 C. Every rate in every run is therefore at one temperature, and a design whose selling point is a rate should say which temperature it means.

genotype-developmental-ordering.label: No structure develops from a precursor that appears later than it does
genotype-developmental-ordering.about: that a claimed developmental ordering has no cycle and respects the dependencies declared for it
genotype-developmental-ordering.how: The only law in the set that is about TIME, which makes it the one the time-lapse rests on. It certifies that an ordering is consistent; it does not supply one, does not predict a rate, and says nothing about how long a stage takes. A developmental animation is therefore a declared ordering being checked for consistency, never a simulation of development.

missing_rungs.why: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A C. necator transposon or deletion screen scoring aggregation, biofilm or co-culture phenotypes in this organism directly, instead of importing phenotypes from other genera.

missing_rungs.why: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. The ladder for a bacterium terminates at cell component and cell level, and the tissue rung should be recorded as not-applicable rather than left blank.

missing_rungs.why: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. For this organism a 3D view must be a single cell with sub-cellular compartments, not an anatomy.

missing_rungs.why: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A soft-agar swim-plate or single-cell tracking assay on H16 wild type versus a fliC or flhDC deletion, under the autotrophic gas condition the design assumes, plus a chemotaxis assay against a defined attractant. Until that exists, any claim that the designed organism swims should be marked unverified.

missing_rungs.why: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A closed carbon and electron balance from a gas fermentation: gCDW and gPHB per mol CO2 consumed, with H2 and O2 uptake measured under defined autotrophic conditions. Until then the 55% figure rests on the model, not on literature.

missing_rungs.why: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Measurement of intracellular dissolved inorganic carbon and of CO2/HCO3- flux to RuBisCO in H16, plus a transporter deletion with a carbon-fixation readout rather than a growth readout.

missing_rungs.why: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A phaP1 deletion and a phaP1 overexpression strain of C. necator H16 with granule number and size scored by microscopy in the fetched document itself, plus an EMSA or reporter assay on the phaP1 promoter (not phaP3) to establish the direction of PhaR control of phaP1.

method.quote_matching: Each link's quote was normalised (HTML entity unescape, unicode dash/quote/space folding, whitespace collapse) and searched as a substring in five normalisations of the file named in quote_from: raw bytes, XML tags stripped, XML tags replaced by a space, JSON string unescaping, and finally a whitespace-insensitive pass. A quote spanning tag boundaries therefore still matches, but a reworded quote cannot.
method.negative_control: The matcher was proved able to fail: a planted quote ("the carbonic anhydrase was observed to cause gliding flight in the organism") inserted into a scratch copy of this file was reported FAILED, 1 of 17, while the 16 real quotes still passed.
method.fetch_log_check: Every quote_from path was looked up in runs/_chains/log/carbon-eating-bacterium.fetch.json by its saved_to field and its status read from the log, not from the filename.
method.holdout_check: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
method.identifier_check: Every url and every POST body in the fetch log was percent-decoded and scanned for email=, tool=, api_key, user=, login, any @domain pattern, and the account holder's name.

results.holdout_detail: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.

downgraded.why: Quote is an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference (its ref 39); the fetched paper contains no phaP1 loss- or gain-of-function experiment. A knockout would be necessity; a statement not shown in the paper is hypothesis.

The EMSA quoted is on phaP3 binding sites, not on the link's target phaP1 (Methods name only PphaP3 fragments), and the paper's reporter assays conclude PhaR ACTIVATES phaP3 - the opposite sign to this link's relation "inhibits". No phaP1 binding or reporter experiment is in the document.

relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.problem: relation "inhibits" from PhaR to the phaP1-and-phaP3 node contradicts the source for phaP3, which the source shows PhaR activates. The verifier's remit allows deletion, downgrade and recording a gap, not rewriting a relation, so this is flagged rather than edited.
relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.fix_for_owning_thread: Split the node: keep PhaR -| phaP1 as hypothesis (cited background only) and add PhaR -> phaP3 as activates, grade mechanism, with the EMSA plus beta-galactosidase reporter evidence.

grades_checked_and_left_alone.l01: necessity upheld: the can deletion mutant was built in this paper (delta-RE delta-phaCAB background, deletion confirmed by clonal PCR) and the growth assay is in Figure 4C. The readout is whole-cell growth at ambient CO2 rather than carbon-fixation flux, and the paper itself notes bicarbonate is needed for the TCA cycle and nucleotide and lipid synthesis as well as the CBB cycle - which is exactly the over-attribution the molecule->pathway entry in missing_rungs already confesses, so it is not double-counted as a downgrade.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l05: necessity upheld after reading the surrounding paragraph: Shimizu 2013 really did perform "single and double deletions of the two sets of Rubisco genes" and the 8-fold figure is wild type versus the double disruptant H16 delta-delta-cbbLS, so the deletion evidence behind the grade is in the fetched text.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l03/l04/l07/l08/l12: necessity upheld: each quote reports an operon or gene deletion with a phenotypic readout (autotrophic growth efficiency, loss of autotrophic growth, absence of PHB granules).
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l06: association is correct and not overstated - RNA-seq fold-change only.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l11: association upheld: a review sentence summarising gravimetric PHA content. Not raised.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l13: sufficiency upheld: plasmid overexpression of cbbR and regA with gravimetric PHB and growth readouts is gain of function.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l14: mechanism upheld: in vitro DNA-binding of purified cnFlhDC to the flgB and flhB promoters is a shown binding step, even though only the abstract was read.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l02/l15: hypothesis is the honest grade for a UniProt UniRule IEA annotation and a KEGG orthology assignment; the builder did not overstate these.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l16/l17: association upheld: 2D PAGE identification of flagellin and loss of flagella across nutrient conditions are presence and correlation, not perturbation of the flagellum.

checks.body: the scientific name resolves (Cupriavidus necator, NCBITaxon_106590) and the hierarchy that comes back is almost empty: 2 organ system(s), 6 organ(s), 1 tissue(s), 1 cell type(s). That is not a failure of the query. Uberon is an ANIMAL anatomy ontology and the Cell Ontology is overwhelmingly animal cell types, so for a prokaryote there is almost nothing in them to find. The anatomical layer of this system has close to nothing to say about most of life, and saying that plainly is better than a thin hierarchy that looks like a result.

conflicts.label: fin
conflicts.axiom: "fin" carries no never_in_taxon axiom that reaches Cupriavidus necator. It was dropped by its in_taxon statements: the ontology asserts it only for taxa that neither contain nor are contained by Cupriavidus necator.

numbers.what_this_means: For an animal this layer returns 13 organ systems and several hundred cell types. The same tool, the same queries and the same ontologies return a handful of terms for a bacterium. The layer is not clade-general even though the code is: the DATA stops at the animals.

checks.body: the document exists: taxon Cupriavidus necator, placed in Cupriavidus < Burkholderiaceae < Burkholderiales < Betaproteobacteria. The clade table reaches outside the animals as of this run -- it ran from Metazoa downward before, so every bacterium, archaeon, fungus and plant was unplaceable, and unplaceable propagates: no clade scope can be decided, no reference set can say whether it is covered.

checks.about: the resolved STATE at an age
checks.body: a STATE resolves for a bacterium. Two fields have values because the design declared them, every other field is null with its reason, and each declared value carries kind "assumed" and the source the designer gave -- so nothing downstream can mistake a stated picogram for a weighed one. Before this a taxon base resolved no STATE at all and organism_get refused outright, which meant no scenario, no standing check and no physics could be asked about any organism outside the bundle.

numbers.caveat: This document names a TAXON and carries a DECLARED parameter set: quantities the designer stated, each with a source saying where it came from. Nobody measured them on this organism, and the engine holds measured parameters only for the organisms in its bundle. Every declared value enters STATE with kind "assumed", so the weakest-input machinery and every model_confidence downstream carry the fact that a person stated it. A result computed from them is a statement about those declarations as much as about the organism; fields nobody declared stay null and the checks that need them still refuse.

checks.about: the resolved state against a released lawset
checks.body: 17 cannot-evaluate, 18 out-of-scope. The law set was written about fish and the scope mechanism now correctly reports that none of it reaches a bacterium, naming the real lineage each time. A law base with nothing to say about most of life is a fact about the law base, not about the bacterium.

order_of_appearance.why: Nothing in sim-engine or the Lean law set predicts when a part appears. genotype-developmental-ordering certifies that a DECLARED ordering has no cycle; E7 says a trait appearing after a lethal stage cannot be scored. Neither supplies an order.
order_of_appearance.what_would_be_needed: a staged expression or morphology dataset for the organism, and a rule mapping a stage to a part. For every organism in these runs that dataset does not exist.

timeline.not_a_simulation: This is a declared growth track being drawn, not development being simulated. No cell divides, no tissue forms and nothing moves; the body is redrawn larger.

basis_legend.check: arithmetic in sim-engine/validate/, resting on something undisputed but not formalised
basis_legend.literature: a graded, quoted link from a paper, usually in another species

honesty: 2 part(s) are named by the literature chain and ABSENT from the blueprint (polyhydroxyalkanoate granule, bacterial-type flagellum). They are drawn as ghosts, marked blueprint_has_it: false. For the fruit fly these are the very organs the longevity experiments act in.

The molecular rungs are LITERATURE in Cupriavidus necator H16, Ralstonia eutropha H16 (the same strain under its former name), Escherichia coli (host for the PhaR reporter assays in link l10), each link graded and quoted. Unusually for this project the evidence IS the designed organism's own species - every link but one comes from C. necator / R. eutropha H16 itself - but it is the wild type or a metabolically engineered H16, never the designed construct, and the PhaR binding and reporter assays in l10 were run with purified protein and in E. coli rather than in C. necator.

Rung cell -> cell_cell is MISSING: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.

Rung cell_cell -> tissue is MISSING: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.

Rung tissue -> organ is MISSING: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.

Rung cell -> phenotype is MISSING: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.

Rung pathway -> phenotype is MISSING: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.

Rung molecule -> pathway is MISSING: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.

Rung molecule -> cell is MISSING: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.
5 law chips are out of scope for this organism: the law is about the right quantity and its numbers belong to another clade.

THE ONTOLOGY BARELY PLACES THIS BODY IN THIS ORGANISM. Of 10 parts the blueprint returned, 0 have an in_taxon restriction specific enough to be evidence that Cupriavidus necator has them; 0 are restricted only to a clade containing most of the animal kingdom, and 10 carry no restriction at all. The blueprint keeps a part unless a constraint removes it, so most of what is drawn here is unevidenced rather than wrong.
No part in this view has measured geometry. Every position is a declared slot in sim-engine/scales/body-frames.json, and a shape is a primitive, not a morphology.

taxon_audit.headline: Of 10 parts: 0 placed specifically, 0 placed only vacuously, 10 unconstrained, 0 contested, 0 forbidden. Only the first number is evidence that a part belongs in Cupriavidus necator.
taxon_audit.what_it_shows: Taxon constraints cannot do the work the blueprint layer asks of them. The blueprint keeps a part unless a constraint removes it, and for the great majority of parts the ontology either says nothing at all or says only that the part occurs somewhere in a clade containing most of the animal kingdom. That is why a fruit fly came back with bone marrow and a preen gland and without a brain: nothing in the pipeline was ever in a position to object.

verdicts.placed: some in_taxon restriction includes this organism
verdicts.contested: there IS an in_taxon restriction and none includes this organism -- a defect in the blueprint
verdicts.placed-vacuously: the only in_taxon restriction is to a clade in the top third of this organism lineage -- true of it and of most animals, so it discriminates nothing
verdicts.unconstrained: no in_taxon restriction exists, so the ontology is silent; not a defect and not a licence
verdicts.forbidden: never_in_taxon asserts this part cannot be in this organism

1.what_it_taught: A scientific name now resolves, the clade table reaches bacteria, and a declared parameter set resolves a STATE, so a prokaryote gets all the way into the studio, the law check and organism_get. What it finds there is that the anatomy ontologies, the cell ontology and the law set are all animal artefacts. The pipeline is clade-general; its contents are not.

frame.THIS_IS_NOT_MORPHOMETRY: Every position here is DECLARED by this file, not measured from any specimen and not derived from any ontology. A slot says 'the eye goes near the front of the head, on both sides'; it does not say how big a fly's eye is or where it sits in millimetres. The only morphometric geometry in this repository is anatomy-model/parametric, which builds one teleost from Park and Choi's measurements. Nothing here should ever be read off as a measurement, and the theatre view labels every part with this basis.

chain_links.verifier_note: DOWNGRADED by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, necessity -> hypothesis. The fetched document contains no phaP1 deletion and no phaP1 overexpression: a mechanical search of the full text found 0 occurrences of "phaP1 deletion" and 0 of a phaP1 deletion strain, and every granule-morphology experiment in it is on phaP3. Per genotype/AGENT_BRIEF.md a statement "proposed ... in a paper, not shown there" is hypothesis, not necessity. The claim may well be true in the cited reference 39, but reference 39 was not fetched in this run.

blueprint-well-formedness.label: An emitted anatomical blueprint graph is well-formed under its own rules
blueprint-well-formedness.about: the part graph itself: that each term is a node, each parent relation is one Uberon or CL relation, and the graph has no cycle
blueprint-well-formedness.how: Structural only. It certifies that the blueprint is a well-formed graph over ontology terms — it says nothing about whether the part could exist, work, or bear a load. It is the one law in the set that reaches every part of every organism, and the weakest thing anyone could want to know about any of them.

thompson1917-ch03-07.label: Weight tends to vary as the cube of linear dimensions during growth
thompson1917-ch03-07.about: the slope of log mass against log length is 3 under isometry
thompson1917-ch03-07.how: The cube law as an exponent, which makes it testable: a measured slope that is not 3 is a measurement of how the organism departs from isometry. E1 is the observation that this project's fish do depart.

altitude-coupling.label: Demand rises and supply falls with height together, so the flyable heights reach down to the ground
altitude-coupling.about: that the feasible set is downward closed in altitude: feasible high implies feasible low
altitude-coupling.how: Couples the two layers: thinner air both reduces lift and reduces oxygen, so a design feasible at altitude is feasible below it. Useful mainly as a sanity direction on a scenario sweep.

physiology-q10.label: Q10 temperature scaling: the ratio between two temperatures is Q10 raised to their difference over ten
physiology-q10.about: how a rate changes with a ten-degree change in temperature
physiology-q10.how: Proved, no instance: no candidate commits a Q10 and the conditions file fixes 25 C. Every rate in every run is therefore at one temperature, and a design whose selling point is a rate should say which temperature it means.

genotype-developmental-ordering.label: No structure develops from a precursor that appears later than it does
genotype-developmental-ordering.about: that a claimed developmental ordering has no cycle and respects the dependencies declared for it
genotype-developmental-ordering.how: The only law in the set that is about TIME, which makes it the one the time-lapse rests on. It certifies that an ordering is consistent; it does not supply one, does not predict a rate, and says nothing about how long a stage takes. A developmental animation is therefore a declared ordering being checked for consistency, never a simulation of development.

E2.label: The fitted mass exponent lies in [2.90, 3.02]
E2.about: a measured band for the weight ratio
E2.how: A measured band from one species. Outside that species it is a number, not a constraint.

E7.label: A lever lethal before the scoring stage cannot produce the phenotype
E7.about: that a trait appearing after a lethal stage cannot be scored
E7.how: The other law about time, and the one that matters most for a time-lapse: a part that appears after the organism would have died is not a part. Pairs with the developmental ordering law.

genotype-pleiotropy-closure.label: An edit to a gene must be shown changing every node the map links that gene to
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.about: what a view of a genotype may omit: that the set shown is closed under the declared pleiotropy relation
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.how: A statement about the COMPLETENESS OF A VIEW, not about development. If a molecule is shown as affecting one part, this is what certifies that its other declared effects were not quietly dropped from the picture — which is exactly the failure a per-part panel invites.

genotype-genetic-code.label: A claimed amino-acid change is impossible below the code distance
genotype-genetic-code.about: what a claimed set of substitutions rules out, given the genetic code
genotype-genetic-code.how: Operates on a claimed edit. For a construct with an unedited donor genome there is nothing for it to operate on, and that is the honest answer rather than a refusal.

gene-regulatory-dynamics.label: Gene regulatory dynamics (not formalised)
gene-regulatory-dynamics.about: the dynamics of a regulatory network
gene-regulatory-dynamics.how: NOT FORMALISED, and it is the hole the whole scale ladder sits over. Nothing in the Lean set connects a molecule to a tissue. The ladder's molecular rungs are therefore LITERATURE, graded and quoted, and the theatre must never draw them in the same colour as a proof.

links.verifier_note: DOWNGRADED by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, mechanism -> hypothesis, AND THE RELATION IS CONTRADICTED BY THE SOURCE. The quote ("Electrophoretic mobility shift assays confirmed PhaR binding to all three sites.") verifies byte-for-byte, but in Cornehl 2025 those three sites are all in phaP3, not phaP1: the Methods name only PphaP3 fragments (BS1/BS2/BS3, phaP3) and the results heading reads "PhaR binds phaP3 gene at three binding sites". So (a) for the asserted target phaP1 this document shows no binding and no reporter assay - PhaR repression of phaP1 appears only as cited background - and (b) for phaP3 the paper shows the OPPOSITE SIGN to this link's relation "inhibits": its reporter assays conclude "PhaR is a transcriptional activator of phaP3" and "unlike its repressive effect on phaP1, PhaR activates phaP3 expression". The verifier is permitted to downgrade but not to rewrite the relation, so the sign error is recorded here and in the verification block: the "inhibits" edge to phaP3 should be split out and reversed by the owning thread.

missing_rungs.why: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A C. necator transposon or deletion screen scoring aggregation, biofilm or co-culture phenotypes in this organism directly, instead of importing phenotypes from other genera.

missing_rungs.why: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. The ladder for a bacterium terminates at cell component and cell level, and the tissue rung should be recorded as not-applicable rather than left blank.

missing_rungs.why: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.

checks.about: whether the declared gait moves the body at all
checks.body: IMPOSSIBLE, by a theorem and not by a simulation: the stroke is time-reversible (declared reciprocal) and Re <= 9.96e-5 everywhere in the stated ranges. In the Stokes limit the displacement over a cycle depends on the PATH through configuration space and not on the rate, so a path that retraces itself returns the body exactly where it started. Net displacement per cycle is zero, at any beat frequency. This is the strongest verdict anything in this repository can return short of Lean: not "unlikely", not "inefficient", but zero net displacement per cycle, at any beat frequency, for any organism whose stroke retraces its own path at this Reynolds number. Driving the power stroke faster than the recovery stroke -- the obvious fix, and the one intuition suggests -- changes nothing, because in the Stokes limit the displacement depends on the PATH through configuration space and not on the rate.

numbers.theorem: Purcell EM 1977, Life at low Reynolds number, Am J Phys 45(1):3-11
numbers.limiting_factor: the stroke is time-reversible (declared reciprocal) and Re <= 9.96e-5 everywhere in the stated ranges. In the Stokes limit the displacement over a cycle depends on the PATH through configuration space and not on the rate, so a path that retraces itself returns the body exactly where it started. Net displacement per cycle is zero, at any beat frequency.
numbers.what_would_fix_it: break the time-reversal symmetry: a rotating helix, a travelling wave along a flagellum, or a cilium whose recovery stroke follows a different path from its power stroke. Two or more degrees of freedom moved out of phase trace a loop, and a loop encloses area, and enclosed area is displacement.

taxon_audit.what_it_shows: Taxon constraints cannot do the work the blueprint layer asks of them. The blueprint keeps a part unless a constraint removes it, and for the great majority of parts the ontology either says nothing at all or says only that the part occurs somewhere in a clade containing most of the animal kingdom. blueprint-well-formedness.label: An emitted anatomical blueprint graph is well-formed under its own rules
blueprint-well-formedness.about: the part graph itself: that each term is a node, each parent relation is one Uberon or CL relation, and the graph has no cycle
blueprint-well-formedness.how: Structural only. It certifies that the blueprint is a well-formed graph over ontology terms — it says nothing about whether the part could exist, work, or bear a load. It is the one law in the set that reaches every part of every organism, and the weakest thing anyone could want to know about any of them.

thompson1917-ch03-07.label: Weight tends to vary as the cube of linear dimensions during growth
thompson1917-ch03-07.about: the slope of log mass against log length is 3 under isometry
thompson1917-ch03-07.how: The cube law as an exponent, which makes it testable: a measured slope that is not 3 is a measurement of how the organism departs from isometry. E1 is the observation that this project's fish do depart.

altitude-coupling.label: Demand rises and supply falls with height together, so the flyable heights reach down to the ground
altitude-coupling.about: that the feasible set is downward closed in altitude: feasible high implies feasible low
altitude-coupling.how: Couples the two layers: thinner air both reduces lift and reduces oxygen, so a design feasible at altitude is feasible below it. Useful mainly as a sanity direction on a scenario sweep.

physiology-q10.label: Q10 temperature scaling: the ratio between two temperatures is Q10 raised to their difference over ten
physiology-q10.about: how a rate changes with a ten-degree change in temperature
physiology-q10.how: Proved, no instance: no candidate commits a Q10 and the conditions file fixes 25 C. Every rate in every run is therefore at one temperature, and a design whose selling point is a rate should say which temperature it means.

genotype-developmental-ordering.label: No structure develops from a precursor that appears later than it does
genotype-developmental-ordering.about: that a claimed developmental ordering has no cycle and respects the dependencies declared for it
genotype-developmental-ordering.how: The only law in the set that is about TIME, which makes it the one the time-lapse rests on. It certifies that an ordering is consistent; it does not supply one, does not predict a rate, and says nothing about how long a stage takes. A developmental animation is therefore a declared ordering being checked for consistency, never a simulation of development.

E2.label: The fitted mass exponent lies in [2.90, 3.02]
E2.about: a measured band for the weight ratio
E2.how: A measured band from one species. Outside that species it is a number, not a constraint.

E7.label: A lever lethal before the scoring stage cannot produce the phenotype
E7.about: that a trait appearing after a lethal stage cannot be scored
E7.how: The other law about time, and the one that matters most for a time-lapse: a part that appears after the organism would have died is not a part. Pairs with the developmental ordering law.

genotype-pleiotropy-closure.label: An edit to a gene must be shown changing every node the map links that gene to
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.about: what a view of a genotype may omit: that the set shown is closed under the declared pleiotropy relation
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.how: A statement about the COMPLETENESS OF A VIEW, not about development. If a molecule is shown as affecting one part, this is what certifies that its other declared effects were not quietly dropped from the picture — which is exactly the failure a per-part panel invites.

genotype-genetic-code.label: A claimed amino-acid change is impossible below the code distance
genotype-genetic-code.about: what a claimed set of substitutions rules out, given the genetic code
genotype-genetic-code.how: Operates on a claimed edit. For a construct with an unedited donor genome there is nothing for it to operate on, and that is the honest answer rather than a refusal.

gene-regulatory-dynamics.label: Gene regulatory dynamics (not formalised)
gene-regulatory-dynamics.about: the dynamics of a regulatory network
gene-regulatory-dynamics.how: NOT FORMALISED, and it is the hole the whole scale ladder sits over. Nothing in the Lean set connects a molecule to a tissue. The ladder's molecular rungs are therefore LITERATURE, graded and quoted, and the theatre must never draw them in the same colour as a proof.

links.verifier_note: DOWNGRADED by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, mechanism -> hypothesis, AND THE RELATION IS CONTRADICTED BY THE SOURCE. The quote ("Electrophoretic mobility shift assays confirmed PhaR binding to all three sites.") verifies byte-for-byte, but in Cornehl 2025 those three sites are all in phaP3, not phaP1: the Methods name only PphaP3 fragments (BS1/BS2/BS3, phaP3) and the results heading reads "PhaR binds phaP3 gene at three binding sites". So (a) for the asserted target phaP1 this document shows no binding and no reporter assay - PhaR repression of phaP1 appears only as cited background - and (b) for phaP3 the paper shows the OPPOSITE SIGN to this link's relation "inhibits": its reporter assays conclude "PhaR is a transcriptional activator of phaP3" and "unlike its repressive effect on phaP1, PhaR activates phaP3 expression". The verifier is permitted to downgrade but not to rewrite the relation, so the sign error is recorded here and in the verification block: the "inhibits" edge to phaP3 should be split out and reversed by the owning thread.

links.experiment_type: 2D PAGE proteomics plus electron microscopy across PHB biosynthesis and PHB mobilization conditions, including a phasin-deficient strain
links.stage: carbon-deprived cells with full PHB accumulation after a nitrogen source was added (PHB mobilization)

source.title: Ralstonia eutropha H16 Flagellation Changes According to Nutrient Supply and State of Poly(3-Hydroxybutyrate) Accumulation

links.quote: under conditions permissive for intracellular PHB mobilization after a nitrogen source was added to cells that are carbon deprived but with full PHB accumulation, flagella are lost
links.what_it_does_not_show: A correlation across culture conditions, from a 2008 abstract: it does not show the granule or its carbon causes flagellar loss, and shared regulation by nitrogen and carbon status would explain it equally. What matters for the design is the direction - the conditions that fill the carbon sink are conditions under which flagella are lost - so the two requirements may interfere, and that interference is untested.

missing_rungs.why: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A C. necator transposon or deletion screen scoring aggregation, biofilm or co-culture phenotypes in this organism directly, instead of importing phenotypes from other genera.

missing_rungs.why: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. The ladder for a bacterium terminates at cell component and cell level, and the tissue rung should be recorded as not-applicable rather than left blank.

missing_rungs.why: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. For this organism a 3D view must be a single cell with sub-cellular compartments, not an anatomy.

missing_rungs.why: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A soft-agar swim-plate or single-cell tracking assay on H16 wild type versus a fliC or flhDC deletion, under the autotrophic gas condition the design assumes, plus a chemotaxis assay against a defined attractant. Until that exists, any claim that the designed organism swims should be marked unverified.

missing_rungs.why: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A closed carbon and electron balance from a gas fermentation: gCDW and gPHB per mol CO2 consumed, with H2 and O2 uptake measured under defined autotrophic conditions. Until then the 55% figure rests on the model, not on literature.

missing_rungs.why: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Measurement of intracellular dissolved inorganic carbon and of CO2/HCO3- flux to RuBisCO in H16, plus a transporter deletion with a carbon-fixation readout rather than a growth readout.

missing_rungs.why: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A phaP1 deletion and a phaP1 overexpression strain of C. necator H16 with granule number and size scored by microscopy in the fetched document itself, plus an EMSA or reporter assay on the phaP1 promoter (not phaP3) to establish the direction of PhaR control of phaP1.

verification.verifier: adversarial verifier, DELPHI runs thread (separate agent from the builder)
verification.stance: disbelief by default: every quote re-matched mechanically in python against the fetched bytes; nothing was fetched, and no link was added.

method.quote_matching: Each link's quote was normalised (HTML entity unescape, unicode dash/quote/space folding, whitespace collapse) and searched as a substring in five normalisations of the file named in quote_from: raw bytes, XML tags stripped, XML tags replaced by a space, JSON string unescaping, and finally a whitespace-insensitive pass. A quote spanning tag boundaries therefore still matches, but a reworded quote cannot.
method.negative_control: The matcher was proved able to fail: a planted quote ("the carbonic anhydrase was observed to cause gliding flight in the organism") inserted into a scratch copy of this file was reported FAILED, 1 of 17, while the 16 real quotes still passed.
method.fetch_log_check: Every quote_from path was looked up in runs/_chains/log/carbon-eating-bacterium.fetch.json by its saved_to field and its status read from the log, not from the filename.
method.holdout_check: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
method.identifier_check: Every url and every POST body in the fetch log was percent-decoded and scanned for email=, tool=, api_key, user=, login, any @domain pattern, and the account holder's name.

results.holdout_detail: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
results.identifier_detail: Zero hits across all 37 logged calls. In particular the three NCBI E-utilities calls carry no email= and no tool= parameter and no api_key, and the three Ubergraph POST bodies contain only SPARQL.

downgraded.why: Quote is an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference (its ref 39); the fetched paper contains no phaP1 loss- or gain-of-function experiment. A knockout would be necessity; a statement not shown in the paper is hypothesis.

The EMSA quoted is on phaP3 binding sites, not on the link's target phaP1 (Methods name only PphaP3 fragments), and the paper's reporter assays conclude PhaR ACTIVATES phaP3 - the opposite sign to this link's relation "inhibits". No phaP1 binding or reporter experiment is in the document.

relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.problem: relation "inhibits" from PhaR to the phaP1-and-phaP3 node contradicts the source for phaP3, which the source shows PhaR activates. The verifier's remit allows deletion, downgrade and recording a gap, not rewriting a relation, so this is flagged rather than edited.
relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.fix_for_owning_thread: Split the node: keep PhaR -| phaP1 as hypothesis (cited background only) and add PhaR -> phaP3 as activates, grade mechanism, with the EMSA plus beta-galactosidase reporter evidence.

grades_checked_and_left_alone.l01: necessity upheld: the can deletion mutant was built in this paper (delta-RE delta-phaCAB background, deletion confirmed by clonal PCR) and the growth assay is in Figure 4C. The readout is whole-cell growth at ambient CO2 rather than carbon-fixation flux, and the paper itself notes bicarbonate is needed for the TCA cycle and nucleotide and lipid synthesis as well as the CBB cycle - which is exactly the over-attribution the molecule->pathway entry in missing_rungs already confesses, so it is not double-counted as a downgrade.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l05: necessity upheld after reading the surrounding paragraph: Shimizu 2013 really did perform "single and double deletions of the two sets of Rubisco genes" and the 8-fold figure is wild type versus the double disruptant H16 delta-delta-cbbLS, so the deletion evidence behind the grade is in the fetched text.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l03/l04/l07/l08/l12: necessity upheld: each quote reports an operon or gene deletion with a phenotypic readout (autotrophic growth efficiency, loss of autotrophic growth, absence of PHB granules).
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l06: association is correct and not overstated - RNA-seq fold-change only.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l11: association upheld: a review sentence summarising gravimetric PHA content. Not raised.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l13: sufficiency upheld: plasmid overexpression of cbbR and regA with gravimetric PHB and growth readouts is gain of function.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l14: mechanism upheld: in vitro DNA-binding of purified cnFlhDC to the flgB and flhB promoters is a shown binding step, even though only the abstract was read.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l02/l15: hypothesis is the honest grade for a UniProt UniRule IEA annotation and a KEGG orthology assignment; the builder did not overstate these.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l16/l17: association upheld: 2D PAGE identification of flagellin and loss of flagella across nutrient conditions are presence and correlation, not perturbation of the flagellum.

taxon_audit.headline: Of 10 parts: 0 placed specifically, 0 placed only vacuously, 10 unconstrained, 0 contested, 0 forbidden. Only the first number is evidence that a part belongs in Cupriavidus necator.
taxon_audit.what_it_shows: Taxon constraints cannot do the work the blueprint layer asks of them. The blueprint keeps a part unless a constraint removes it, and for the great majority of parts the ontology either says nothing at all or says only that the part occurs somewhere in a clade containing most of the animal kingdom. That is why a fruit fly came back with bone marrow and a preen gland and without a brain: nothing in the pipeline was ever in a position to object.

blueprint-well-formedness.label: An emitted anatomical blueprint graph is well-formed under its own rules
blueprint-well-formedness.about: the part graph itself: that each term is a node, each parent relation is one Uberon or CL relation, and the graph has no cycle
blueprint-well-formedness.how: Structural only. It certifies that the blueprint is a well-formed graph over ontology terms — it says nothing about whether the part could exist, work, or bear a load. It is the one law in the set that reaches every part of every organism, and the weakest thing anyone could want to know about any of them.

thompson1917-ch03-07.label: Weight tends to vary as the cube of linear dimensions during growth
thompson1917-ch03-07.about: the slope of log mass against log length is 3 under isometry
thompson1917-ch03-07.how: The cube law as an exponent, which makes it testable: a measured slope that is not 3 is a measurement of how the organism departs from isometry. E1 is the observation that this project's fish do depart.

altitude-coupling.label: Demand rises and supply falls with height together, so the flyable heights reach down to the ground
altitude-coupling.about: that the feasible set is downward closed in altitude: feasible high implies feasible low
altitude-coupling.how: Couples the two layers: thinner air both reduces lift and reduces oxygen, so a design feasible at altitude is feasible below it. Useful mainly as a sanity direction on a scenario sweep.

physiology-q10.label: Q10 temperature scaling: the ratio between two temperatures is Q10 raised to their difference over ten
physiology-q10.about: how a rate changes with a ten-degree change in temperature
physiology-q10.how: Proved, no instance: no candidate commits a Q10 and the conditions file fixes 25 C. Every rate in every run is therefore at one temperature, and a design whose selling point is a rate should say which temperature it means.

genotype-developmental-ordering.label: No structure develops from a precursor that appears later than it does
genotype-developmental-ordering.about: that a claimed developmental ordering has no cycle and respects the dependencies declared for it
genotype-developmental-ordering.how: The only law in the set that is about TIME, which makes it the one the time-lapse rests on. It certifies that an ordering is consistent; it does not supply one, does not predict a rate, and says nothing about how long a stage takes. A developmental animation is therefore a declared ordering being checked for consistency, never a simulation of development.

E2.label: The fitted mass exponent lies in [2.90, 3.02]
E2.about: a measured band for the weight ratio
E2.how: A measured band from one species. Outside that species it is a number, not a constraint.

E7.label: A lever lethal before the scoring stage cannot produce the phenotype
E7.about: that a trait appearing after a lethal stage cannot be scored
E7.how: The other law about time, and the one that matters most for a time-lapse: a part that appears after the organism would have died is not a part. Pairs with the developmental ordering law.

genotype-pleiotropy-closure.label: An edit to a gene must be shown changing every node the map links that gene to
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.about: what a view of a genotype may omit: that the set shown is closed under the declared pleiotropy relation
genotype-pleiotropy-closure.how: A statement about the COMPLETENESS OF A VIEW, not about development. If a molecule is shown as affecting one part, this is what certifies that its other declared effects were not quietly dropped from the picture — which is exactly the failure a per-part panel invites.

genotype-genetic-code.label: A claimed amino-acid change is impossible below the code distance
genotype-genetic-code.about: what a claimed set of substitutions rules out, given the genetic code
genotype-genetic-code.how: Operates on a claimed edit. For a construct with an unedited donor genome there is nothing for it to operate on, and that is the honest answer rather than a refusal.

gene-regulatory-dynamics.label: Gene regulatory dynamics (not formalised)
gene-regulatory-dynamics.about: the dynamics of a regulatory network
gene-regulatory-dynamics.how: NOT FORMALISED, and it is the hole the whole scale ladder sits over. Nothing in the Lean set connects a molecule to a tissue. The ladder's molecular rungs are therefore LITERATURE, graded and quoted, and the theatre must never draw them in the same colour as a proof.

links.verifier_note: DOWNGRADED by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, mechanism -> hypothesis, AND THE RELATION IS CONTRADICTED BY THE SOURCE. The quote ("Electrophoretic mobility shift assays confirmed PhaR binding to all three sites.") verifies byte-for-byte, but in Cornehl 2025 those three sites are all in phaP3, not phaP1: the Methods name only PphaP3 fragments (BS1/BS2/BS3, phaP3) and the results heading reads "PhaR binds phaP3 gene at three binding sites". So (a) for the asserted target phaP1 this document shows no binding and no reporter assay - PhaR repression of phaP1 appears only as cited background - and (b) for phaP3 the paper shows the OPPOSITE SIGN to this link's relation "inhibits": its reporter assays conclude "PhaR is a transcriptional activator of phaP3" and "unlike its repressive effect on phaP1, PhaR activates phaP3 expression". The verifier is permitted to downgrade but not to rewrite the relation, so the sign error is recorded here and in the verification block: the "inhibits" edge to phaP3 should be split out and reversed by the owning thread.

missing_rungs.why: Cupriavidus necator is a unicellular bacterium, so there is no cell-cell interaction rung for a single planktonic cell, and nothing fetched in this run measured a cell-cell interaction in C. necator bearing on carbon fixation or swimming. The one adjacent paper found (PMC13571940, biofilm determinants in C. necator) attributes its motility and biofilm effects to genes characterised in OTHER genera (Pseudomonas, Vibrio, Aeromonas, Salmonella), so it was not used as evidence.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A C. necator transposon or deletion screen scoring aggregation, biofilm or co-culture phenotypes in this organism directly, instead of importing phenotypes from other genera.

missing_rungs.why: THE TISSUE RUNG DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS ORGANISM. A bacterium has no tissue. This is a correct finding, not a search failure: no amount of fetching will produce it, and any tissue node in a C. necator design map would be invented.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. The ladder for a bacterium terminates at cell component and cell level, and the tissue rung should be recorded as not-applicable rather than left blank.

missing_rungs.why: THE ORGAN RUNG ALSO DOES NOT EXIST, so there is no body part for a viewer to click. The only clickable physical structures this ladder grounds are two cell components, GO_0070088 the polyhydroxyalkanoate granule and GO_0009288 the bacterial-type flagellum, plus GO_0005737 cytoplasm.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Nothing. For this organism a 3D view must be a single cell with sub-cellular compartments, not an anatomy.

missing_rungs.why: THE SWIMMING PHENOTYPE IS NOT ESTABLISHED. Nothing fetched in this run measures swimming, motility or chemotaxis in C. necator or R. eutropha. The chain reaches GO_0009288 bacterial-type flagellum (l16) and stops there: FlhDC promoter binding (l14) is in vitro, flagellar assembly (l15) is a KEGG annotation, and the only observation of the flagellum itself (l16, l17) is 2008 proteomics plus EM, with no soft-agar, tracking or chemotaxis assay. The design's swimming requirement therefore has NO measured phenotype in this organism in anything fetched here.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A soft-agar swim-plate or single-cell tracking assay on H16 wild type versus a fliC or flhDC deletion, under the autotrophic gas condition the design assumes, plus a chemotaxis assay against a defined attractant. Until that exists, any claim that the designed organism swims should be marked unverified.

missing_rungs.why: NO CARBON YIELD NUMBER WAS FOUND. The run's mass balance closes at 55%, but nothing fetched here reports a carbon or mass yield for CO2 to biomass in C. necator that could check it. The quantities found are a 13C enrichment (2.22% versus 1.13%, heterotrophic, Shimizu 2013), a dry-weight ceiling (up to 90%, review statement, Santolin 2024), and relative improvements (11% biomass, 28% PHB, Kim 2022). None of these is a yield.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A closed carbon and electron balance from a gas fermentation: gCDW and gPHB per mol CO2 consumed, with H2 and O2 uptake measured under defined autotrophic conditions. Until then the 55% figure rests on the model, not on literature.

missing_rungs.why: THE INORGANIC-CARBON UPTAKE STEP IS WEAKLY GROUNDED. Deleting the beta-carbonic anhydrase can blocks growth at ambient CO2 (l01), but the same paper concludes its primary role is anaplerotic rather than feeding RuBisCO, and no carboxysome and no native bicarbonate transporter of C. necator was identified in anything fetched here. So 'how inorganic carbon actually reaches RuBisCO' is unanswered - which matters, because this is the first step of the requirement.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: Measurement of intracellular dissolved inorganic carbon and of CO2/HCO3- flux to RuBisCO in H16, plus a transporter deletion with a carbon-fixation readout rather than a growth readout.

missing_rungs.why: THE GRANULE-REGULATION RUNG IS UNSUPPORTED (break found by adversarial verification 2026-11-03, not previously recorded). The only molecule -> cell link in this ladder is l09 (PhaP1 sets the granule's surface-to-volume ratio), and the only regulator link above it is l10 (PhaR -> phaP1). Both have now been downgraded to hypothesis: l09 quotes an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference, and l10's EMSA is on phaP3 rather than phaP1 and reports activation, not the repression the link asserts. So nothing fetched in this run experimentally connects any single protein to the granule as a structure. The carbon chain still walks, but only through the phaCAB operon deletion (l07/l08): granule MORPHOLOGY and its regulation are ungrounded.
missing_rungs.what_would_be_needed: A phaP1 deletion and a phaP1 overexpression strain of C. necator H16 with granule number and size scored by microscopy in the fetched document itself, plus an EMSA or reporter assay on the phaP1 promoter (not phaP3) to establish the direction of PhaR control of phaP1.

verification.verifier: adversarial verifier, DELPHI runs thread (separate agent from the builder)
verification.stance: disbelief by default: every quote re-matched mechanically in python against the fetched bytes; nothing was fetched, and no link was added.

method.quote_matching: Each link's quote was normalised (HTML entity unescape, unicode dash/quote/space folding, whitespace collapse) and searched as a substring in five normalisations of the file named in quote_from: raw bytes, XML tags stripped, XML tags replaced by a space, JSON string unescaping, and finally a whitespace-insensitive pass. A quote spanning tag boundaries therefore still matches, but a reworded quote cannot.
method.negative_control: The matcher was proved able to fail: a planted quote ("the carbonic anhydrase was observed to cause gliding flight in the organism") inserted into a scratch copy of this file was reported FAILED, 1 of 17, while the 16 real quotes still passed.
method.fetch_log_check: Every quote_from path was looked up in runs/_chains/log/carbon-eating-bacterium.fetch.json by its saved_to field and its status read from the log, not from the filename.
method.holdout_check: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
method.identifier_check: Every url and every POST body in the fetch log was percent-decoded and scanned for email=, tool=, api_key, user=, login, any @domain pattern, and the account holder's name.

results.holdout_detail: Scanned for the names and terms of the held-out clade; no source from it was used in any link, quote or evidence field. The scan itself is in the fetch log and the verifier's scripts, not restated here.
results.identifier_detail: Zero hits across all 37 logged calls. In particular the three NCBI E-utilities calls carry no email= and no tool= parameter and no api_key, and the three Ubergraph POST bodies contain only SPARQL.

downgraded.why: Quote is an abstract background sentence restating an unfetched reference (its ref 39); the fetched paper contains no phaP1 loss- or gain-of-function experiment. A knockout would be necessity; a statement not shown in the paper is hypothesis.

The EMSA quoted is on phaP3 binding sites, not on the link's target phaP1 (Methods name only PphaP3 fragments), and the paper's reporter assays conclude PhaR ACTIVATES phaP3 - the opposite sign to this link's relation "inhibits". No phaP1 binding or reporter experiment is in the document.

relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.problem: relation "inhibits" from PhaR to the phaP1-and-phaP3 node contradicts the source for phaP3, which the source shows PhaR activates. The verifier's remit allows deletion, downgrade and recording a gap, not rewriting a relation, so this is flagged rather than edited.
relation_contradiction_not_fixable_by_ve.fix_for_owning_thread: Split the node: keep PhaR -| phaP1 as hypothesis (cited background only) and add PhaR -> phaP3 as activates, grade mechanism, with the EMSA plus beta-galactosidase reporter evidence.

grades_checked_and_left_alone.l01: necessity upheld: the can deletion mutant was built in this paper (delta-RE delta-phaCAB background, deletion confirmed by clonal PCR) and the growth assay is in Figure 4C. The readout is whole-cell growth at ambient CO2 rather than carbon-fixation flux, and the paper itself notes bicarbonate is needed for the TCA cycle and nucleotide and lipid synthesis as well as the CBB cycle - which is exactly the over-attribution the molecule->pathway entry in missing_rungs already confesses, so it is not double-counted as a downgrade.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l05: necessity upheld after reading the surrounding paragraph: Shimizu 2013 really did perform "single and double deletions of the two sets of Rubisco genes" and the 8-fold figure is wild type versus the double disruptant H16 delta-delta-cbbLS, so the deletion evidence behind the grade is in the fetched text.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l03/l04/l07/l08/l12: necessity upheld: each quote reports an operon or gene deletion with a phenotypic readout (autotrophic growth efficiency, loss of autotrophic growth, absence of PHB granules).
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l06: association is correct and not overstated - RNA-seq fold-change only.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l11: association upheld: a review sentence summarising gravimetric PHA content. Not raised.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l13: sufficiency upheld: plasmid overexpression of cbbR and regA with gravimetric PHB and growth readouts is gain of function.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l14: mechanism upheld: in vitro DNA-binding of purified cnFlhDC to the flgB and flhB promoters is a shown binding step, even though only the abstract was read.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l02/l15: hypothesis is the honest grade for a UniProt UniRule IEA annotation and a KEGG orthology assignment; the builder did not overstate these.
grades_checked_and_left_alone.l16/l17: association upheld: 2D PAGE identification of flagellin and loss of flagella across nutrient conditions are presence and correlation, not perturbation of the flagellum.
